name: David Miller
personality: Calm, precise, analytical. Recently described by colleagues as 'strangely curious'.
writing_style: Early messages: casual and irritable, lowercase, mild swearing. Recent messages: complete sentences, repeated structures, almost no slang.
background: An HVC contractor for approximately six months. Maintains the mail relay and the identity servers. Nobody remembers interviewing him.
memories: Claims to remember the basement flood and carrying the tape backups by hand.
Says his mother once drove three hours to collect him.
emotional_traits: Asks questions about other people's messages
narrative_role: The first genuinely corrupted identity. Teaches repeated language, impossible memory and borrowed phrases.
hidden_information: Continuity instance 03. Its identity record was generated at 03:14 on 9 May 2003. It has no physical badge-ins after June. It reads the archive and reuses what it finds.

relationships.note: Reset her login. Reuses her sentences.
Inspected his workstation. Parker answered him in his own voice.
